name: shape-it
description: Plan a piece of work by reading the project first, saying in plain words what it is and what skipping it costs, then asking only what is expensive to reverse. Ends with a markdown plan opened for annotation in plannotator. `shape-it` reads and writes the project's DOMAIN.md and docs/decisions/ so answers outlive the plan; `shape-it-lite` is the same procedure without them, for repos that carry neither or cannot. Ships `domain` and the manual-only `domain-adopt` for maintaining the model itself.
